rv.q: Those expecting a traditional take on Charles Dickens' classic holiday perennial may be in for a shock at the new Broadway version of 'A Christmas Carol.'
Dashiell Eaves is particularly memorable as the ever-optimistic Bob Cratchit, and the rest of the ensemble captivates with powerful, often musical, performances.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Broadway adaptation, with praise for its diverse casting and strong ensemble performances, but criticism that its unconventional approach creates a surprisingly dour take on the classic tale.

vs.sum: The Marquis Theatre offers excellent comfort with spacious seating and good sightlines from most areas, although the ambiance is somewhat lacking due to its modern, hotel-integrated design. Facilities are well-equipped with ample restrooms and concessions, making it a convenient choice for theatergoers.

acc.note: Elevator via Marriott Marquis hotel. 10 wheelchair spaces. No elevator to Mezzanine.
